coordination_residual_semantics: arithmetic remainder after measured source and inclusive route wait; it includes motion/service and uninstrumented coordination, so it is not by itself a causal coordination estimate
merge_semantics: merge_wait is a diagnostic subset of inclusive route wait and is never added to the time bank; v2 has no equivalent J2 instrument
runtime_boundary: v2-safe is an offline comparator; no v2 route, reservation, or future state is a runtime feature
